subject: Weekend hike logistics
text:
Hi there,

I wanted to touch base about the weekend hike because the message I got earlier left me a bit mixed up. It said we should meet at the trailhead near the main parking lot by ten, but then it added that folks might need to check in with the guide first. I'm not sure whether that means everyone should arrive earlier, if only the new participants need to do that, or if the guide will simply be roaming around waiting for people. Could you let me know the best way to keep everyone on track without turning the morning into a scramble? Also, if there's a spot that's easier for the van to unload supplies, maybe we can use that instead of the smaller gravel area. If there's a printed schedule or a link with the final plan, sending that over would save me from fielding a bunch of guesses and second questions. I just want people to feel prepared without dragging out the whole day. I'm leaning toward telling folks ten sharp, but I'd rather not guess if the first stop shifts things.
